name: Caerulescent-Col
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
signal of unknown origin bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
There is money in rare flora, water, exotic matter and biomass and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
